zh.metaDesc: 選擇你或朋友的處境，從和合本找到合適的經文，附上下文說明、祝福、禱告與版畫插畫。
zh.kicker: 和合本 1919 · 29 個主題 · 免費使用
zh.lede: 「神的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。」
zh.q1: 1　你需要的是 選一類，下面的狀況會跟著篩選
zh.formNote: 選一個最接近的狀況就好，不需要打字，也不會傳出任何資料。
zh.cardPick: 選一處經文 祝福、禱告與圖卡都會跟著換
zh.indexSub: 點一個主題，直接看經文、祝福與禱告
zh.about1p: 每一段經文都直接取自和合本（1919，公有領域），不改寫、不摘句。展開「看上下文」可以讀到前後各五節。
zh.about2p: 每段經文都附上說話者、對象、原意和應用；容易被誤用的經文另外標出提醒，避免斷章取義。
zh.about3p: 這是輔助靈修的工具，內容是依主題預先寫好的，不一定完全貼合你的處境。重要的決定請與牧者、屬靈同伴一起禱告；身心危機請尋求專業協助。
zh.footer: 經文：和合本（繁體）公有領域・資料來源 scrollmapper/bible_databases

js.pickFirst: 請先選一個最接近的狀況。
js.tapAgain: 圖卡已備好，再按一次存到相簿

en.metaDesc: Choose the situation you or a friend is in and find fitting Bible passages from the World English Bible, with context, a blessing, a prayer, and a linocut-style print.
en.kicker: World English Bible · 29 topics · free to use
en.lede: “For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.”
en.q1: 1　What you need Pick one; the situations below will filter
en.formNote: Just pick the closest situation. No typing needed, and nothing you choose is sent anywhere.
en.cardPick: Choose a passage The blessing, prayer, and card change with it
en.indexSub: Pick a topic to go straight to the passages, blessing, and prayer
en.about1h: Scripture from the World English Bible
en.about1p: Every passage is quoted directly from the World English Bible (public domain), unedited and not cut into fragments. Open "See the context" to read the five verses before and after.
en.about2p: Each passage comes with notes on who is speaking, to whom, what it originally meant, and how it applies; passages that are easily misused carry an extra caution so they aren't taken out of context.
en.about3p: This is a tool to support devotion. Its content is written in advance for each topic and may not fit your situation exactly. Pray through important decisions with a pastor or a trusted fellow believer, and for physical or mental health crises please seek professional help.
en.footer: Scripture: World English Bible, public domain · source eBible.org

js.seeCtx: See the context (five verses before and after)
js.pickFirst: Please choose the closest situation first.
js.tapAgain: Card ready, tap again to save
